Lao Trade Portal: Ordinance on Value-Added Tax rate (amendment) No. 003/POL of 19 March 2024 — rate rises from 7% back to 10%; Ministry of Finance Notice 1360 applied 10% from 1 May 2024

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
Laos cut VAT from 10% to 7% on 1 January 2022 (Presidential Decree 231/P, COVID relief — pre-window) and restored 10% from 1 May 2024 (Ordinance 003/POL plus MOF Notice 1360).
